svg.title: RL360 agentic reinforcement learning architecture
svg.desc: Miles sends tasks to RL360 and Harbor agents and collects trajectories and rewards. Agents use task sandboxes for tools and verification, and call SGLang inference engines through Miles session tracing and the SMG gateway. Megatron-LM trains on collected batches and synchronizes updated policy weights to SGLang. Task-specific reward functions and retrieval utilities live in the RL360 source packages.
